description: A provider adapter detects, from raw wire evidence, that an argument fragment arrived after the call it belongs to already ended, and reports this explicitly as a provider_diagnostic (this detection happens in the adapter, against raw provider events - not at this normalized layer, which is why the diagnostic itself is the fixture's input rather than a bare late delta; a late tool_call_arguments_delta with no such diagnostic instead falls through to this package's general trailing-data handling and resolves retry/stream_incomplete, not reject). Once reported, the coordinator/gate must fail the call closed rather than accept it.

provenance.note: Models E_TOOL_ARGUMENTS_AFTER_END, emitted by every current provider adapter (OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, the AI SDK adapter) when raw evidence shows this exact pattern.

events.message: Argument evidence arrived after this call's own terminal event.
